title: Withings Body Smart Wi-Fi Scale
description: Track weight and body composition with the Withings Body Smart scale. The color display gives a quick read at weigh-in, and the Withings app syncs measurements over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.

title: PETLIBRO Polar Smart Wet Food Feeder
description: The PETLIBRO Polar schedules wet-food meals from the PETLIBRO app. The covered feeder has three meal compartments and a cooling system designed for wet food.

title: Definitive Technology BP9040 Tower Speaker with Powered Subwoofer
description: The BP9040 is a floorstanding home theater speaker with front- and rear-firing drivers for a broad soundstage. An integrated 8-inch powered subwoofer and two passive radiators handle low frequencies.

title: Segway Ninebot MAX G2 Folding Electric Scooter
description: The Segway Ninebot MAX G2 commuter scooter has a folding stem, front and rear suspension, a wide standing deck, and a handlebar display.

title: Aventon Level.2 Step-Over Commuter E-Bike, Clay, Regular
description: Aventon’s Level.2 step-over commuter e-bike in Clay, size Regular. It combines torque-sensing pedal assist with a 500 W rear hub motor, hydraulic disc brakes, and front suspension.
